title: manuscript-guard record of the sources copied from Zotero
description: Each file `manuscript-guard sync-sources` wrote under literature/sources/, by its name there: the work it is a copy of, the SHA-256 and size of what was written, whether it is Zotero's file or Zotero's text of a file, and the day. It is how the command knows which files are its own to replace when Zotero's copy changes, and never writes over a file it did not write. It holds no path on anyone's computer.

from.description: `zotero`: the attachment's own file. `zotero-text`: Zotero's text of an attachment whose file is not on this computer, the `.zotero-ft-cache` beside where the file would be.

attachment.description: Zotero's key of the attachment, from its zotero:// link.
